rationales.seed_block: A fresh 64-world block repeats every original and varied open assay without reusing diagnosis worlds.
rationales.recovery_seed_block: A fresh 128-world block measures repaired candidate, controllability, broadcast, and parameter recovery.
rationales.sensitivity_seed_block: A fresh 32-world block samples the repaired stage-local neighborhood.
rationales.initial_structure_prior: A 0.30 persistent complexity prior modestly corrects the diagnosed underweighting; the failed 0.40 attempt bounds the adjustment and recovery tests its false-formation cost.
rationales.structure_transition: A schedule-blind 0.02 formation hazard and 0.005 recovery hazard prevent either candidate from becoming absorbing while remaining inside the declared continuity budget.
rationales.controllability_transition: A symmetric 0.005 hazard lets the posterior summarize accumulated action-transition evidence across a history while still assigning nonzero probability to changing controllability; the failed 0.05 calibration made the final theory-variable readout forget earlier event contexts.
rationales.candidate_evidence_contrasts: Small factor-specific midpoint blends preserve the persistent candidate's downstream couplings while reserving most of the fixed log-evidence budget for explicit accumulation.
rationales.accumulation_weights: The fixed score budget is assigned to inferred uncontrollability and overwhelm under collapsed reflexive broadcast, with a small realized-adverse contribution; an unconditional collapsed-broadcast term is zero because the full varied assay showed that it responded to event count even when controllability evidence did not.
rationales.high_controllability_penalty: The independent penalty is fixed at zero because a development attempt showed it penalized low-control acute worlds before C was identified.
rationales.integrated_control_penalty: A 0.80 high-control-by-integrated penalty makes repeated contextualized controllable events calibrate the transient candidate without changing the positive low-control score bound.
rationales.controllability_evidence_precision: A dimensionless contrast precision of 10 separates the declared low- and high-control action-transition rows around their shared midpoint in event contexts; the finite 0.01 probability floor preserves support, and generation and inference use the identical normalized CPT.
rationales.event_precision_support: Ordinary-event precision 2 makes event contexts identifiable in finite irregular histories; overwhelm remains at the inherited precision 3, so it still sharpens the same likelihood without a separate observation route.
rationales.reflexive_monitor_reliability: A 0.99 stage-local monitor reliability makes collapsed versus integrated reflexive context identifiable before the bounded conjunction contributes; it sharpens the existing likelihood rather than adding evidence.
rationales.accumulation_offset: A small event-conditioned 0.05 base cost keeps non-event slices neutral while conditional penalties carry the transient boundary.
rationales.accumulation_gain: Gain 0.70 preserves relative calibration before the generative factor's declared score bound is applied.
rationales.accumulation_log_score_cap: A symmetric finite-factor log-score cap of 0.80 makes large single-slice posterior jumps structurally impossible; it bounds a declared likelihood potential, never a posterior or readout.
